sentences.en: We need to get you home.
sentences.zh: 我们需要送你回家。

sentences.en: Well, this is a big plot point because it means we're going to say goodbye to Gabe for a little while.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是一个重要的情节转折，因为这意味着我们要暂时和盖博告别了。

sentences.en: Well, Gabe is going to be back in season eight, and this is reminding me we need to reach out to Zach Woods and have him on this podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗯，盖博在第八季会回来，这提醒我我们需要联系扎克·伍兹，邀请他来上我们的播客。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: I have a lot I need to speak with him about.
sentences.zh: 我有很多话想跟他聊。

sentences.en: Zach, I just want to hang out with you.
sentences.zh: 扎克，我只是想和你聚聚。

sentences.en: That's kind of what this podcast is for.
sentences.zh: 这大概就是这个播客的初衷吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Well, Jim is going to walk Joe to her car, and she asked him, how did her friend Nellie do in the interview?
sentences.zh: 吉姆送乔去车上，她问吉姆，她的朋友奈莉面试表现如何？

sentences.en: Jim said, well, we didn't know that Nellie was your friend.
sentences.zh: 吉姆说，嗯，我们不知道奈莉是你的朋友。

sentences.en: And Joe is like, that's a kind of classy move, right?
sentences.zh: 乔就说，这招挺高明的，对吧？

sentences.en: But Jim's like, you know, we still don't think she's a good fit.
sentences.zh: 但吉姆说，你知道，我们还是觉得她不太合适。

sentences.en: And then this is a surprise moment.
sentences.zh: 然后这是一个令人惊讶的时刻。

sentences.en: Joe tells Jim, go ahead and give Dwight an interview.
sentences.zh: 乔告诉吉姆，去给德怀特一个面试机会吧。

sentences.en: I like a little crazy.
sentences.zh: 我就喜欢带点疯狂劲儿的。

sentences.en: I can't believe she's going to give him another interview after everything.
sentences.zh: 真不敢相信，发生了这么多事，她竟然还要再采访他一次。

sentences.en: And then her trunk opens.
sentences.zh: 然后她的后备箱打开了。

sentences.en: Did you see how it opens onto Jim?
sentences.zh: 你看到它打开时正好对着吉姆了吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, and he like bends out of the way.
sentences.zh: 看到了，他就像是弯腰躲开了。

sentences.en: Up next is one of my favorite Oscar moments for the whole entire season seven.
sentences.zh: 接下来是第七季中我最喜欢的奥斯卡时刻之一。

sentences.en: What is it?
sentences.zh: 是什么？

sentences.en: It is just one of those tiny throwaway moments, but it made me laugh so hard.
sentences.zh: 那只是一个微不足道的小插曲，但我当时笑得特别厉害。

sentences.en: I rewound the scene and watched it again.
sentences.zh: 我把那一幕倒回去又看了一遍。

sentences.en: Oscar's going to walk up to front reception to drop off a package.
sentences.zh: 奥斯卡走到前台去送一个包裹。

sentences.en: A gray sock puppet with a red bow greets him.
sentences.zh: 一个系着红蝴蝶结的灰色袜子木偶向他打招呼。

sentences.en: Oscar says, Aaron, what are you doing?
sentences.zh: 奥斯卡说：“亚伦，你在干什么？”

sentences.en: Aaron says, I've been turned into a puppet.
sentences.zh: 亚伦说：“我变成了一个木偶。”

sentences.en: And Oscar goes, okay.
sentences.zh: 奥斯卡回了句：“好吧。”

sentences.en: And just walks away.
sentences.zh: 然后就直接走开了。

sentences.en: Doesn't entertain the puppet.
sentences.zh: 完全没理会那个木偶。

sentences.en: Doesn't stay around to find out why.
sentences.zh: 也没留下来问个究竟。

sentences.en: He's like, no, okay.
sentences.zh: 他就像是说，不，好吧。

sentences.en: I loved it so much.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢这一幕了。

sentences.en: We got a fan question from Kristen S.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了一位粉丝克里斯汀·S的提问。

sentences.en: In New Brunswick, Canada, who said,
sentences.zh: 她来自加拿大新不伦瑞克省，她说：

sentences.en: Kevin's talking head about the puppets is what I believe to be the most underrated comedy bit in the office.
sentences.zh: 凯文关于木偶的采访片段，我认为是《办公室》里最被低估的喜剧桥段。

sentences.en: I laugh out loud every time.
sentences.zh: 我每次看都忍不住大笑。

sentences.en: My son plays it for me just to hear me laugh.
sentences.zh: 我儿子专门放给我看，就是为了听我笑。

sentences.en: Brian Baumgartner's earnest delivery is perfection.
sentences.zh: 布莱恩·鲍姆加特纳那本正经的演绎简直完美。

sentences.en: Well, Kristen, I totally agreed with you.
sentences.zh: 嗯，克里斯汀，我完全同意你的看法。

sentences.en: And I felt like we should hear this talking head.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们应该重温一下这个采访片段。

sentences.en: It's just that I wish the puppets would talk more about the alphabet.
sentences.zh: 我只是希望木偶们能多讲讲字母表。

sentences.en: Not for me, but if any kids are watching, A, B, and so forth.
sentences.zh: 不是为了我，但如果有孩子在看的话，A、B之类的。

sentences.en: You know, M-N-L-O, P, F.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，M-N-L-O，P，F。

sentences.en: Yes, this is the moment we find out that Kevin thinks M-N-L-O is a letter in the alphabet,
sentences.zh: 没错，这一刻我们发现凯文认为M-N-L-O是字母表里的字母，

sentences.en: which brought me to this, Jenna.
sentences.zh: 这让我想到了这一点，珍娜。

sentences.en: His last name is Malone.
sentences.zh: 他的姓是马龙（Malone）。

sentences.en: He has an M, he has an L, an O, and an N in his name.
sentences.zh: 他的名字里有M、L、O和N。

sentences.en: Can he spell his name?
sentences.zh: 他会拼自己的名字吗？

sentences.en: It doesn't seem like it.
sentences.zh: 看起来好像不会。

sentences.en: Perhaps not.
sentences.zh: 或许吧。

sentences.en: Well, the hand puppet is going to explain that she needs a date with the best salesman in the office, Andy Bernard.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那个手偶要解释说她想和办公室里最棒的销售员安迪·伯纳德约会。

sentences.en: Yeah, Andy walks over and he says he's flattered,
sentences.zh: 对，安迪走过去说他很受宠若惊，

sentences.en: but he doesn't think that they should date.
sentences.zh: 但他觉得他们不应该约会。

sentences.en: Ouch.
sentences.zh: 哎哟。

sentences.en: Oh, I mean, I would just have to, that would be it.
sentences.zh: 噢，我的意思是，如果是我，那肯定就完了。

sentences.en: I would leave.
sentences.zh: 我会直接走人。

sentences.en: I'm done working here.
sentences.zh: 我不干了。

sentences.en: Bye, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家再见。

sentences.en: That's so embarrassing.
sentences.zh: 那太尴尬了。

sentences.en: I would not be able to come back from that.
sentences.zh: 我肯定没法面对这种局面。

sentences.en: He has a talking head that is really a series of talking heads, I guess, right?
sentences.zh: 他有一个采访片段，其实是一系列采访片段，对吧？

sentences.en: He gives a lot of reasons for why he doesn't think they should date, that, you know, Aaron's his best friend, but he just didn't feel it.
sentences.zh: 他给出了很多理由解释为什么觉得他们不该约会，你知道的，比如亚伦是他最好的朋友，但他就是没那种感觉。

sentences.en: Or he's got a really weird thing about how, like, sometimes you really want to like things, but you just can't seem to, like Mad Men or football.
sentences.zh: 或者他有一种很奇怪的想法，就是有时候你真的很想喜欢某些东西，但就是喜欢不起来，比如《广告狂人》或者橄榄球。

sentences.en: And then he sort of says, like, maybe he got over Aaron.
sentences.zh: 然后他大概说了句，也许他已经放下亚伦了。

sentences.en: There's, like, so many reasons.
sentences.zh: 怎么说呢，原因实在太多了。

sentences.en: Well, he also said, let's not forget she chose Gabe over me.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他还说，别忘了她选了盖博没选我。

sentences.en: That one hurt.
sentences.zh: 那句话挺伤人的。

sentences.en: But then he ends with, well, actually, she's pretty great.
sentences.zh: 但他最后又补了一句，其实，她真的很不错。

sentences.en: I'm confused.
sentences.zh: 我糊涂了。

sentences.en: I think he is, too.
sentences.zh: 我想他自己也糊涂着呢。

sentences.en: Next up, we get to meet the new bridezilla in the office.
sentences.zh: 接下来，我们要见识一下办公室里新晋的“新娘怪兽”。

sentences.en: I really loved doing this scene.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢拍这场戏。

sentences.en: Angela has only been engaged a few hours.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉订婚才不过几个小时。

sentences.en: You guys, like a few hours, like three hours, and she's already making big plans and telling people they're not going to be invited.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，才几个小时，也就三个小时吧，她就开始做各种宏大的计划，还告诉别人他们没份参加。

sentences.en: She's like, Stanley, I won't be able to invite everyone to the wedding because we want to keep it to $3.50.
sentences.zh: 她对斯坦利说，我没法邀请所有人参加婚礼，因为我们想把预算控制在3.5美元以内。

sentences.en: Stanley's like, I'll get over it.
sentences.zh: 斯坦利回她，我会挺过来的。

sentences.en: Angela's like, I mean, we just have to see how many senators and members of Congress want to attend before we can open it up, you know, to regular people.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉又说，我的意思是，我们得先看看有多少参议员和国会议员想来，才能决定要不要邀请普通人。

sentences.en: And then she says, Pam, you know how you and Jim did your ironic wedding?
sentences.zh: 然后她说，帕姆，你记得你和吉姆办的那场反讽式婚礼吗？

sentences.en: Do you still have the plans for the dream wedding that you couldn't afford?
sentences.zh: 你们还有那场你们办不起的梦幻婚礼的计划书吗？

sentences.en: And Pam says, that was our dream wedding.
sentences.zh: 帕姆说，那场就是我们的梦幻婚礼。

sentences.en: And Angela says, Niagara Falls?
sentences.zh: 安吉拉说，尼亚加拉大瀑布？

sentences.en: Pregnant?
sentences.zh: 怀孕了？

sentences.en: That was your dream?
sentences.zh: 那就是你们的梦想？

sentences.en: Pork medallions?
sentences.zh: 猪肉奖章？

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: She is going to be horrible to deal with.
sentences.zh: 跟她打交道肯定会很痛苦。

sentences.en: Pam gives a little look to Oscar.
sentences.zh: 帕姆看了奥斯卡一眼。

sentences.en: And he gives her a look back like, Pam.
sentences.zh: 奥斯卡回了她一个眼神，好像在说，帕姆啊。

sentences.en: And then she goes, very weighted.
sentences.zh: 然后她开口了，语气非常沉重。

sentences.en: She says, Angela, I hope you have a very beautiful wedding.
sentences.zh: 她说，安吉拉，我希望你能拥有一场非常美丽的婚礼。

sentences.en: That ain't what she really means.
sentences.zh: 她心里可不是这么想的。

sentences.en: Well, let's take a break because when we come back, Kelly has joined the search committee.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们先休息一下，回来后凯莉会加入搜寻委员会。

sentences.en: And things are going to get a little dicey.
sentences.zh: 事情会变得有点棘手。

sentences.en: We're back from break.
sentences.zh: 我们休息回来了。

sentences.en: And before we keep breaking down this episode, Angela, I have something for you.
sentences.zh: 在继续拆解这一集之前，安吉拉，我有个东西要给你。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: You know, we haven't had a chance to talk about our live show in Vancouver that we did.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们还没机会聊聊我们在温哥华办的那场现场秀。

sentences.en: We haven't talked about it on the pod.
sentences.zh: 我们在播客里还没提过呢。

sentences.en: It was so amazing.
sentences.zh: 那场秀太棒了。

sentences.en: I mean, a lot of what was so amazing about it was just all of the really good best friend time that we had.
sentences.zh: 我是说，之所以那么棒，很大程度上是因为我们俩度过了非常美好的闺蜜时光。

sentences.en: I know I made a bunch of stories over at Office Ladies Pod.
sentences.zh: 我知道我在Office Ladies播客账号上发了很多故事。

sentences.en: I saved it as a highlight.
sentences.zh: 我还把它存成了精选。

sentences.en: But what a fun time to just go explore Vancouver a little bit.
sentences.zh: 能去温哥华稍微逛逛真是太开心了。

sentences.en: Well, during the show, there was a moment that took us both by surprise.
sentences.zh: 在演出期间，有一个瞬间让我们俩都感到意外。

sentences.en: I was not surprised by it.
sentences.zh: 我倒是一点都不意外。

sentences.en: You weren't?
sentences.zh: 你不意外？

sentences.en: You know what I'm talking about.
sentences.zh: 你知道我在说什么。

sentences.en: I remember I said, I said, listen, if we do this show in Texas, this moment's going to kill.
sentences.zh: 我记得我说过，听着，如果我们去德克萨斯办这场秀，这个梗绝对会炸场。

sentences.en: I'm not so sure about Vancouver.
sentences.zh: 在温哥华我就没那么确定了。

sentences.en: Well, during the show, we have a moment where we discuss Chunk It versus Chuck It.
sentences.zh: 演出时，我们讨论了“Chunk It”和“Chuck It”的用法。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And we asked the audience, almost 4,000 people in attendance, amazing crowd, lovely people.
sentences.zh: 我们问了现场观众，将近4000人，非常棒的观众，可爱的人们。

sentences.en: Well, do any of you say Chunk It?
sentences.zh: 你们有谁说“Chunk It”吗？

sentences.en: Not a single person.
sentences.zh: 一个人都没有。

sentences.en: No one in Vancouver says Chunk It.
sentences.zh: 温哥华根本没人说“Chunk It”。

sentences.en: And I was like, okay, okay.
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，好吧，好吧。

sentences.en: Well, I told you earlier that I went to our general mailbag this week, Angela, and I found this letter.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，我之前跟你说过，这周我翻了翻我们的普通信箱，然后发现了这封信。

sentences.en: And in honor of that crickets moment at our Vancouver Live show.
sentences.zh: 为了纪念我们在温哥华现场演出时那段冷场的时刻。

sentences.en: It was so funny.
sentences.zh: 那真的太搞笑了。

sentences.en: I wanted to give you this gift.
sentences.zh: 我想送你这份礼物。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Via Madeline from Utah, who says, I was just watching Modern Family, and on Season 3, Episode 9, they say Chunk It.
sentences.zh: 来自犹他州的玛德琳说，我刚才在看《摩登家庭》，第三季第九集里，他们说了“Chunk It”。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不会吧。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 真的。

sentences.en: In fact, the title of the episode is Punkin' Chunkin'.
sentences.zh: 事实上，那一集的标题就是《南瓜投掷大赛》（Punkin' Chunkin'）。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: In the episode, Cameron is trying to prove to the rest of his family that he used a slingshot to fling a pumpkin across a football field.
sentences.zh: 在那一集里，卡梅隆试图向家人们证明，他曾用弹弓把一个南瓜弹射过整个橄榄球场。

sentences.en: And in this episode, they all refer to this as Chunkin' the Pumpkin.
sentences.zh: 在这一集里，他们都把这称为“投掷南瓜”（Chunkin' the Pumpkin）。

sentences.en: Yes!
sentences.zh: 没错！

sentences.en: Madeline said, I just thought Angela would be so grateful.
sentences.zh: 玛德琳说，我只是觉得安吉拉一定会非常感激。

sentences.en: And Angela, I recorded this audio clip for you.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，我为你录下了这段音频。

sentences.en: So, this is just one tiny moment from the episode where they repeatedly say Chunkin'.
sentences.zh: 这只是那一集里的一小段，他们反复提到了“Chunkin'”。

sentences.en: I'm just saying maybe you take Punkin' Chunkin' out of the rotation.
sentences.zh: 我只是说，也许你可以把“南瓜投掷大赛”从你的故事库里删掉。

sentences.en: I guess you're right.
sentences.zh: 我想你是对的。

sentences.en: Maybe I could juSt...
sentences.zh: 也许我可以……

sentences.en: You stick to the ones that really happened because people love those.
sentences.zh: 你还是坚持讲那些真实发生过的故事吧，因为大家很喜欢那些。

sentences.en: Excuse me, what?
sentences.zh: 抱歉，你说什么？

sentences.en: I'm just saying people laugh more at stories that are true.
sentences.zh: 我只是说，人们对真实的故事笑得更开心。

sentences.en: Punkin' Chunkin' is a true story.
sentences.zh: “南瓜投掷大赛”是个真实的故事。

sentences.en: True-ish?
sentences.zh: 算是真实吧？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: True.
sentences.zh: 就是真实的。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: The length of a football field.
sentences.zh: 一个橄榄球场的长度。

sentences.en: Through the sunroof of a car that was opened in late November in Missouri.
sentences.zh: 穿过一辆在十一月下旬开着天窗的车，地点在密苏里州。

sentences.en: It was unseasonably warm.
sentences.zh: 当时天气异常温暖。

sentences.en: Explains of fog rolling over the hill.
sentences.zh: 解释了雾气如何翻过山丘。

sentences.en: And who's Cody?
sentences.zh: 还有，科迪是谁？

sentences.en: Who you're close enough to Chunk with, but mysteriously only appears in this story.
sentences.zh: 那个跟你关系好到能一起投掷南瓜，却神秘地只出现在这个故事里的人。

sentences.en: Cody was KIA in Desert Storm.
sentences.zh: 科迪在沙漠风暴行动中阵亡了。

sentences.en: He's a hero.
sentences.zh: 他是位英雄。

sentences.en: You know, all this from someone who's never even chunked a Punkin'.
sentences.zh: 你知道吗，这些话竟然出自一个从未投掷过南瓜的人之口。

sentences.en: I've never longed a Tonkin' either.
sentences.zh: 我也从来没去过东京（Tonkin'）。

sentences.en: You know, these aren't real things.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这些根本不是真实存在的东西。

sentences.en: There you go, Angela.
sentences.zh: 给你，安吉拉。

sentences.en: A whole episode of Chunkin' It!
sentences.zh: 整整一集都在说“Chunkin' It”！

sentences.en: Madeline, I want to thank you from the bottom of my heart.
sentences.zh: 玛德琳，我要从心底里感谢你。

sentences.en: You know, I know people say Chunkin' out there somewhere, but it was pretty amazing when 4,000 people were like, nope.
sentences.zh: 我知道外面确实有人会说“Chunkin'”，但当四千人异口同声说“没有”的时候，那种感觉真是太奇妙了。

sentences.en: I do want to say a big thank you to everyone at Just for Laughs Vancouver.
sentences.zh: 我确实想对温哥华“欢笑节”的所有人说声大大的感谢。

sentences.en: You guys were awesome.
sentences.zh: 你们太棒了。

sentences.en: Thank you to everyone who came out.
sentences.zh: 感谢所有到场的朋友。

sentences.en: And one thing, though, that happened with the Vancouver audience, which I thought was amazing, is I asked if anyone could speak Indonesian.
sentences.zh: 不过，在温哥华观众身上发生了一件我觉得很神奇的事，就是我问有没有人会说印尼语。

sentences.en: And there were several people that could speak Indonesian.
sentences.zh: 结果有好几个人都会说印尼语。

sentences.en: I was so thrilled.
sentences.zh: 我当时太激动了。

sentences.en: And I yelled out to them.
sentences.zh: 我当时冲他们大喊。

sentences.en: And we had a moment.
sentences.zh: 我们当时心领神会。

sentences.en: First of all, Phyllis is going to let us know that she got the call from the, I guess,
sentences.zh: 首先，菲利斯会告诉我们她接到了，我猜是，

sentences.en: DNA offices or adoption agency.
sentences.zh: DNA鉴定中心或者领养机构的电话。

sentences.en: You know, the DNA offices.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就是DNA鉴定中心。

sentences.en: You know.
sentences.zh: 你懂的。

sentences.en: They're by the DMV.
sentences.zh: 就在车管所旁边。

sentences.en: It's like post office, DMV, the DNA office.
sentences.zh: 就像邮局、车管所、DNA鉴定中心那样。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, they called and she and Erin are not related.
sentences.zh: 他们打电话来说，她和艾琳没有血缘关系。

sentences.en: But she's going to tell her another day.
sentences.zh: 但她打算改天再告诉艾琳。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: They've been enjoying, I guess, this idea that maybe Phyllis is her mom.
sentences.zh: 她们一直很享受这种猜测，觉得菲利斯可能是她妈妈。

sentences.en: And she also encouraged Erin to really go for Andy and Erin did it with a sock puppet
sentences.zh: 而且她还鼓励艾琳勇敢去追安迪，结果艾琳用袜子木偶表白，

sentences.en: and was told no in front of everyone.
sentences.zh: 当着所有人的面被拒绝了。

sentences.en: So maybe not the best day to get additional bad news.
sentences.zh: 所以这可能不是告诉她更多坏消息的好日子。

sentences.en: Good point.
sentences.zh: 有道理。

sentences.en: The episode ends with a bunch of talking heads from all the various candidates about, you
sentences.zh: 这一集最后是一连串各路候选人的访谈片段，谈论他们

sentences.en: know, whether or not they think they're going to get this job as the manager.
sentences.zh: 是否觉得自己能得到经理这个职位。

sentences.en: They end with Finger Lakes guy.
sentences.zh: 最后是那个“手指湖”哥们儿。

sentences.en: We finally meet the guy who was so worried about getting the first two weeks off work
sentences.zh: 我们终于见到了那个一直担心请不到前两周假

sentences.en: to go to the Finger Lakes.
sentences.zh: 去手指湖度假的家伙。

sentences.en: And it's Jim Carrey.
sentences.zh: 而且是金·凯瑞。

sentences.en: Brent Forrester was the person in charge of reaching out to Jim Carrey's reps.
sentences.zh: 布伦特·福雷斯特负责联系金·凯瑞的经纪人。

sentences.en: Brent said that Jim Carrey was an enthusiastic yes.
sentences.zh: 布伦特说金·凯瑞非常爽快地答应了。

sentences.en: And incidentally, Jim Carrey received a nomination for favorite TV guest star at the
sentences.zh: 顺便提一下，金·凯瑞凭借这次客串获得了

sentences.en: 38th People's Choice Awards for this cameo.
sentences.zh: 第38届人民选择奖最受欢迎电视客串明星的提名。

sentences.en: Aw, for Finger Lakes guy?
sentences.zh: 噢，是因为“手指湖”那个人吗？

sentences.en: For Finger Lakes guy.
sentences.zh: 就是“手指湖”那个人。

sentences.en: So fun that we got all of these cool guest stars for this episode.
sentences.zh: 这一集能请到这么多酷炫的客串明星真是太有趣了。

sentences.en: It really made it fun to rewatch.
sentences.zh: 重温的时候真的很有意思。

sentences.en: Well, we have one final moment with Creed as branch manager.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们来看看克里德担任分部经理的最后一个片段。

sentences.en: He's talking to his ninth biggest client.
sentences.zh: 他正在和他的第九大客户通话。

sentences.en: It's Pam.
sentences.zh: 是帕姆。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And he thinks the ninth biggest client and his fourth biggest client would get along.
sentences.zh: 他觉得他的第九大客户和第四大客户会聊得来。

sentences.en: And now they have to all talk to each other.
sentences.zh: 现在他们都得互相通话了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So one of my favorite moments in this little bit, I improvised.
sentences.zh: 在这个小片段里，我最喜欢的一个瞬间是我即兴发挥的。

sentences.en: There's the moment when, you know, he says,
sentences.zh: 就是那个瞬间，你知道，他说，

sentences.en: Hey, Jordan, patch through my fourth biggest client.
sentences.zh: 嘿，乔丹，帮我接通我的第四大客户。

sentences.en: And I move the phone across my keyboard.
sentences.zh: 然后我把电话在键盘上划过去。

sentences.en: That was like, that's the patching through sound.
sentences.zh: 那就像是接通电话的声音。

sentences.en: That was a little bit I came up with.
sentences.zh: 那是我自己想出来的小花招。

sentences.en: I loved it.
sentences.zh: 我超喜欢。

sentences.en: And then I got to perform both sides of the conversation, which was, I mean, it delighted me.
sentences.zh: 然后我还能分饰两角进行对话，我是说，这让我乐在其中。

sentences.en: Well, I don't know if anyone else caught it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不知道有没有人注意到。

sentences.en: But remember how Creed said he would intentionally say people's names wrong on purpose,
sentences.zh: 还记得克里德说过他会故意把别人的名字叫错吗，

sentences.en: even if they were written correctly in the script?
sentences.zh: 即使剧本里写得清清楚楚？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 记得。

sentences.en: Well, in this scene, he called Jordan,
sentences.zh: 在这个场景里，他管乔丹叫，

sentences.en: Jordana.
sentences.zh: 乔丹娜。

sentences.en: Oh, nice.
sentences.zh: 噢，不错。

sentences.en: Well, we should say that this is going to end Creed's stint as manager.
sentences.zh: 我们得说，这将是克里德经理生涯的终点。

sentences.en: And we'll also be saying goodbye to Cody Horn, who played Jordan.
sentences.zh: 我们也要和饰演乔丹的科迪·霍恩说再见了。

sentences.en: She does not return in season eight.
sentences.zh: 她不会在第八季回归。

sentences.en: But a lot of new stuff does happen in season eight.
sentences.zh: 但第八季确实会发生很多新鲜事。

sentences.en: And I cannot wait to break down the liSt.
sentences.zh: 我迫不及待想剖析一下清单了。

sentences.en: Oh, I can't wait.
sentences.zh: 噢，我也等不及了。

sentences.en: Before we get to season eight, we had a fun idea, you guys.
sentences.zh: 在进入第八季之前，我们有个好主意，各位。

sentences.en: We think it is time to break down a Keanu Reeves movie.
sentences.zh: 我们觉得是时候剖析一部基努·里维斯的电影了。

sentences.zh: 我们要从《生死时速》开始。

sentences.zh: 没错，在第七季和第八季之间来点清口小菜。

sentences.zh: 下周，我们将剖析《生死时速》。

sentences.zh: 所以下周记得收听，听我们聊聊基努·里维斯和那辆大巴士的一切。

sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家今天的收听。

sentences.zh: 谢谢你，雷恩。
